title: Unsafe deserialization via :erlang.binary_to_term(payload) (elixir) — review required
description: The elixir sink :erlang.binary_to_term(payload) rebuilds objects from bytes, and hostile bytes can instantiate dangerous classes or run callbacks during decoding. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms the input source is trusted or switches to a data-only format.
remediation: Decode untrusted input with Jason/JSON decoding or :safe option review instead of object deserialization. If object graphs are required, sign the bytes and verify before decoding.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any :erlang.binary_to_term(payload) call matches, including decoding of trusted local state. Trust in the byte source needs human review.
